acceptance.validity: All planned sessions complete on same pinned model, no denied tools; locked source unchanged. Missing or invalid sessions are not negative outcomes.
acceptance.trigger: Report positive-read and negative-read counts separately. Description/catalog simulation is not native Skill routing.
acceptance.behavior: Report baseline green, each fixed fault detected/survived/invalid and restored green, plus manual per-test evidence completeness.
acceptance.decision: Adopt only with observed improvement and no observed regression. Both arms perfect = inconclusive. Bundled change cannot isolate positive wording versus completion effect.
acceptance.scope: Python synthetic tasks only, two repeats; no statistical or cross-model generalization.
